page.layout: One scanned image: a book spine lying on a dark background, with gilt lettering, and below it a digitiser's copyright credit block. No printed text block on the page.
page.notes: The gilt spine lettering reads "GOCLENIUS — DE MAGNETICA CURATIONE — 1613", printed upside down on the spine. This is the binding, not a printed page, so it is not transcribed as main text. The lines "Early European Books, Copyright © 2011 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of The Wellcome Trust, London. 2864/A" are the digitiser's banner and are left out.
